name: Haus Hager
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in a scenic spot in Ellmau, Haus Hager welcomes travellers with thoughtfully appointed apartments. It is an ideal haven for exploring the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental.

The Hartkaiser cable car, the KaiserBad Ellmau pool center, and alpine trails are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Hager in Ellmau offers comfortable holiday apartments with panoramic Wilder Kaiser views.
